clips.title: The story
paras: This quest is the fourth chapter in Apothecary Lydon's relentless development of a devastating Forsaken poison in Tarren Mill. With the deadly Elixir of Agony finally brewed, Lydon dispatches Horde champions to Dun Garok to steal a keg of dwarven Shindigger Stout for delivery.

In the damp reaches of Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon works tirelessly on behalf of the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas. Having gathered lethal ingredients from across Hillsbrad, his new concoction is complete. Lydon has no interest in wasting such a potent strain on trivial creatures like frogs or stray dogs; he seeks a real, tangible test against living adversaries.

To stage his experiment, Lydon needs an inconspicuous delivery vehicle. South of Hillsbrad, the Ironforge dwarves have fortified the stronghold of Dun Garok. Lydon directs agents of the Horde to infiltrate the underground barracks and mess halls, slipping past dwarven rifles and axes to purloin a prized keg of Shindigger Stout.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.

Head down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sometimes I get so bored out here in Tarren Mill I like to open up the formaldehyde jar and let the lovely aroma waft through the air. Makes Umpi a little nervous though.
So were you able to get a keg from the Dwarves? I swear if I have to stare at this deadly elixir without using it on someone for another day I am going to scream.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally! Now we are ready for action!
